diagnostics.message: module.aws_iam_elastic_stack:output.access_key_id: explicit depends_on of module.aws_iam_elastic_stack:resource.aws_iam_access_key.this_user is redundant — already implied by attribute references
module.aws_iam_elastic_stack:output.access_secret_key: explicit depends_on of module.aws_iam_elastic_stack:resource.aws_iam_access_key.this_user is redundant — already implied by attribute references

helm_release.elk configures Elasticsearch PVCs with `storageClassName: advanced` as a literal string, so Terraform has no ordering edge to kubernetes_storage_class.advanced. The Helm release can be applied before the storage class exists, leaving the PVCs Pending and the release timing out.

helm_release.prometheus_operator configures Prometheus/Alertmanager PVCs with `storageClassName: advanced` as a literal string, so Terraform has no ordering edge to kubernetes_storage_class.advanced. The release can be applied before the storage class exists.

helm_release.victoria_metrics_k8s_stack configures VMSingle/Alertmanager PVCs with `storageClassName: advanced` as a literal string, so Terraform has no ordering edge to kubernetes_storage_class.advanced. The release can be applied before the storage class exists.

helm_release.loki_stack configures Loki persistence with `storageClassName: advanced` as a literal string, so Terraform has no ordering edge to kubernetes_storage_class.advanced. The release can be applied before the storage class exists.

helm_release.elk references the `elastic-credentials` Secret by name in its chart values, but nothing orders it after kubernetes_secret.elasticsearch_credentials. The ELK pods can start before the Secret exists and fail to mount/read credentials.

helm_release.elk references the `elastic-certificates` Secret by name in its chart values, but nothing orders it after kubernetes_secret.elasticsearch_certificates. Elasticsearch/Kibana pods can start before the TLS Secret exists.

helm_release.elk references the `elasticsearch-s3-user-creds` Secret by name in its chart values, but nothing orders it after kubernetes_secret.elasticsearch_s3_user_creds. Elasticsearch can start before the S3 keystore Secret exists.

helm_release.elk references the `kibana-encryption-key` Secret by name in its chart values, but nothing orders it after kubernetes_secret.kibana_enc_key. Kibana can start before the encryption-key Secret exists.

helm_release.aws_loadbalancer_controller installs a chart whose webhook certificate relies on cert-manager CRDs, but it has no dependency on helm_release.cert_manager. The release can be applied before cert-manager is installed and fail to create its Certificate resources.

module.aws_iam_elastic_stack:output.access_key_id already has an implicit dependency on module.aws_iam_elastic_stack:resource.aws_iam_access_key.this_user through its value expression (`aws_iam_access_key.this_user.id`), so the explicit depends_on is redundant.

module.aws_iam_elastic_stack:output.access_secret_key already has an implicit dependency on module.aws_iam_elastic_stack:resource.aws_iam_access_key.this_user through its value expression (`aws_iam_access_key.this_user.secret`), so the explicit depends_on is redundant.
